title: dan-c crypto paper forward-test snapshot
description: Full book posted by the daily paper job to POST /api/crypto-forward/update and returned by GET /api/crypto-forward/summary. USDT notionals. Not live orders. The parser in src/lib/crypto-forward.ts is the enforcement; this file is the contract.

updatedAt.description: When the daily job built this snapshot. Stored as UTC ISO-8601 with milliseconds.

startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Signal bar that opened the test (the 2026-10-11 daily close). First fills are the next daily open.

reviewDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD review, on or after startDate. The book keeps running after this date unless stopped.

currency.description: All equity, cash, price, and cost figures are USDT. Not GBP.

lines.description: Paper books. The first entry is the primary book (BTC+ETH while close > 100-day SMA).

benchmarks.description: Same shape as lines. Buy-and-hold and the S&P 500 price index live here, not in lines.

id.description: Short slug, unique across lines and benchmarks. Not the word date. Suggested: A, B, C, BH, SPX.

returnPct.description: Percent return from the 5,000 USDT start. 1.5 means +1.5%.

maxDDPct.description: Peak-to-trough return in percent. Zero, or negative. A 57% drawdown is -57.

cash.description: Uninvested USDT in this book. An index benchmark may send 0.

equityCurve.description: Stored sorted by date ascending. Dates are unique and on or after startDate.

symbol.description: Uppercase symbol, such as BTC or ETH. Unique within the book.

weightPct.description: Percent of that coin's sleeve that is invested. 100 means the whole sleeve is in the coin.

equity.description: USDT equity at the daily close.

date.description: Fill time. Stored as UTC ISO-8601 with milliseconds. The UTC date must be on or after startDate.

line.description: Id of a line or a benchmark.

cost.description: USDT fee on this fill. The test charges 0.15% of traded notional.
